findings.summary: Recorded launch command omits required --registration-sha256; superseded by observer parent-command.json which includes it.
findings.failure_scenario: Verbatim execution of launch-command.json fails argparse before claim or write; wasted attempt only. Fix the runbook record; no code refreeze.

findings.summary: parent_run_id check is a substring search of runner.py text, not a check of the state field value.
findings.failure_scenario: Literal appearing anywhere in runner.py satisfies the check while the emitted state field is wrong. Preparation-only, unpinned; not launch-blocking.

findings.summary: mkdir(exist_ok=True) carried from R1 F2; inherited byte-identical; parent observer absence gate covers it.
findings.failure_scenario: Stray pre-existing output dir accepted by launcher if gate bypassed.

findings.summary: forbidden_outputs lr-transition.json declared in registration but not runner-enforced (no runner.py match); carried from R1 F4.
findings.failure_scenario: A future writer could create lr-transition.json undetected by the runner.
